name: agent-dialogue
description: Project messaging tools for the operator-selected ZCode desktop chat

node_executable.title: Node.js executable
node_executable.description: Absolute Node.js 22.13+ executable path. The optional SessionStart hook additionally requires node on PATH.

state_dir.title: Communication space
state_dir.description: Absolute communication state directory matching the operator-generated context.

context_file.title: Private exact-chat context
context_file.description: Absolute private JSON path reserved for this chat and room. May be absent during dialogue_identity bootstrap; generate with mcp-context after exact binding and room setup.

service_file.title: Private ZCode service descriptor
service_file.description: Absolute descriptor created by agent-dialogue zcode init for the selected native project directory.
